descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Come esperto di cura APN (a), si gioca un ruolo cruciale nel fornire cure di alta qualità e compassionevole per i nostri pazienti. In un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo,: - Guidare lo sviluppo e la supervisione di una cura efficace con una forte attenzione alla neuroriabilitazione e garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità. - Valutazioni proattive e collaborazione con i team di assistenza per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e implementare pratiche basate sulle prove. - Mantenere relazioni significative con i colleghi e quindi contribuire a una cultura di gruppo solidale e comunicativa. - offrire formazione e coaching per il personale di cura, consolidare le migliori pratiche e promuovere lo sviluppo professionale continuo. - Partecipazione attiva alla cooperazione interdisciplinare con medici, terapisti e ricercatori per migliorare i risultati e i processi di cura dei pazienti.
• Requisiti Siamo alla ricerca di una capacità di cura resiliente, comunicativa e proattiva che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo. I candidati ideali dovrebbero avere le seguenti caratteristiche: - una qualifica completa di allattamento (HF, FH, DNII, ACP) e una laurea in allattamento o formazione equivalente. - Conoscenza professionale delle cure respiratorie e/o cura intensiva, unita all'esperienza professionale nella neuroriabilitazione. - Conoscere gli standard di qualità nei metodi di cura e di cura, nonché l'esperienza nella gestione del team e coaching. - Un atteggiamento positivo, un alto grado di orientamento del paziente, competenze organizzative e competenze interculturali. - conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese; altre lingue sono vantaggiose. Cosa? Diventa parte del cereneo e beneficia di una carriera soddisfacente in cui: - Assumere un ruolo diverso e responsabile nel nostro innovativo team interdisciplinare. - per godere di opportunità di sviluppo personale e professionale che sono su misura per i vostri obiettivi di carriera. - Uno stipendio competitivo e servizi completi, tra cui l'orario di lavoro adatto alle famiglie e l'accesso alle strutture fitness. - Sconti dei dipendenti, un programma di cibo sovvenzionato, un parcheggio scontato e una cultura aziendale che promuove l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa. Pronto a fare la differenza? Se siete appassionati di esercitare una profonda influenza sulla vita dei pazienti con malattie neurologiche e volete crescere in un ambiente di supporto, vi invitiamo ad applicare. descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione As a care expert APN (a), you play a crucial role in providing high-quality and compassionate care for our patients. In a dynamic and collaborative environment, you will: - Lead the development and supervision of effective care with a strong focus on neurorehabilitation and ensure compliance with quality standards. - Proactive evaluations and collaboration with care teams to identify opportunities for improvement and implement evidence-based practices. - Maintain meaningful relationships with colleagues and thus contribute to a supportive and communicative team culture. - offer training and coaching for nursing staff, consolidating best practices and promoting continuous professional development. - Active participation in in interdisciplinary cooperation with doctors, therapists and researchers to improve patient outcomes and care processes.
• Requisiti We are looking for a resilient, communication-strong and proactive nursing skills that thrives in a collaborative environment. Ideal candidates should have the following characteristics: - A completed nursing qualification (HF, FH, DNII, ACP) and a Bachelor's degree in nursing or equivalent training. - Professional knowledge of respiratory care and/or intensive care, combined with professional experience in neurorehabilitation. - Established knowledge of quality standards in care and care methods as well as experience in team management and coaching. - A positive attitude, a high degree of patient orientation, organizational skills and intercultural competence. - knowledge of German and English; Other languages are advantageous.
• Cosa offriamo Become part of cereneo and benefit from a fulfilling career in which you: - Take on a diverse and responsible role in our innovative interdisciplinary team. - to enjoy opportunities for personal and professional development that are tailored to your career goals. - A competitive salary and comprehensive services, including family-friendly working hours and access to fitness facilities. - Employee discounts, a subsidized food program, discounted parking and a supporting corporate culture that promotes work-life balance. Ready to make a difference? If you are passionate about exerting a profound influence on the lives of patients with neurological diseases and want to grow in a supporting environment, we invite you to apply. descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgaben:
Als Pflegeexperte APN (a) spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Bereitstellung hochwertiger und mitfühlender Pflege für unsere Patienten. In einem dynamischen und kollaborativen Umfeld werden Sie:
• Die Entwicklung und Aufsicht über effektive Pflege mit einem starken Fokus auf Neurorehabilitation leiten und die Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards sicherstellen.
• Proaktive Bewertungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit Pflegeteams durchführen, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und evidenzbasierte Praktiken zu implementieren.
• Bedeutungsvolle Beziehungen zu Kollegen pflegen und so zu einer unterstützenden und kommunikativen Teamkultur beitragen.
• Schulungen und Coaching für das Pflegepersonal anbieten und dabei bewährte Praktiken festigen und kontinuierliche berufliche Entwicklung fördern.
• Aktive Teilnahme an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzten, Therapeuten und Forschern zur Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse und Pflegeprozesse.

Anforderungen:
Wir suchen eine resiliente, kommunikationsstarke und proaktive Pflegefachkraft, die in einem kollaborativen Umfeld gedeiht. Ideale Kandidaten sollten folgende Eigenschaften besitzen:
• Eine abgeschlossene Pflegequalifikation (HF, FH, DNII, AKP) und einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Pflege oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung.
• Fachkenntnisse in der Atemwegspflege und/oder Intensivmedizin, kombiniert mit beruflicher Erfahrung in der Neurorehabilitation.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse der Qualitätsstandards in der Pflege und der Pflegemethoden sowie Erfahrung in der Teamführung und im Coaching.
• Eine positive Einstellung, ein hohes Maß an Patientenorientierung, organisatorische Fähigkeiten und interkulturelle Kompetenz.
• Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch; weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

Wir bieten:
Werden Sie Teil von cereneo und profitieren Sie von einer erfüllenden Karriere, in der Sie:
• Eine vielfältige und verantwortungsvolle Rolle in unserem innovativen interdisziplinären Team übernehmen.
• Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung genießen, die auf Ihre Karriereziele abgestimmt sind.
• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und umfassende Leistungen erhalten, einschließlich familienfreundlicher Arbeitszeiten und Zugang zu Fitnessanlagen.
• Mitarbeiter Rabatte, ein subventioniertes Essensprogramm, vergünstigte Parkplätze und eine unterstützende Unternehmenskultur genießen, die Work-Life-Balance fördert. Bereit, einen Unterschied zu machen?
Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, einen tiefgreifenden Einfluss auf das Leben von Patienten mit neurologischen Erkrankungen auszuüben und in einem unterstützenden Umfeld wachsen möchten, laden wir Sie ein, sich zu bewerben. Werden Sie Teil unserer cereneo-Familie und helfen Sie, die Zukunft der Rehabilitation zu gestalten. Jetzt bewerben!

Job Description Duties - Ensure therapeutic offer compliance and quality in the field of speech therapy - Continuous development of therapeutic services and implementation of the latest research findings - Personal leadership of the speech therapy unit and optimization of interdisciplinary collaboration with projects - Development of the internal therapeutic concept and quality control through weekly patient discussions - Interface with care and other therapeutic entities and development of interdisciplinary collaboration - Preparation of the internal training calendar and quality control of patient documentation - Contribution to the quality management system - Professional diagnosis and therapy of language, voice, communication, and swallowing disorders in neurological patients, particularly those with tracheostomies - Development, implementation, and evaluation of individualized therapeutic plans to improve swallowing function and communication capacity - Execution of measures for decannulation in close collaboration with physicians, nursing staff, and physiotherapists - Teaching and consultation for patients, families, and nursing staff on the use of tracheostomies - Documentation and evaluation of therapeutic progress according to clinical standards
• Requirements - University degree in speech therapy (with recognition by EDK or willingness to obtain such recognition) - PhD preferred - Extensive experience in the field of speech therapy - Certified training in tracheostomy management - Experience in rehabilitative therapy and management of tracheostomies and dysphagia - Scientific work attitude and interest in implementing new research knowledge - Enjoyment of independent work and proximity to patients within an interdisciplinary team - Responsibility, reflective ability, and high social and communication skills - Excellent oral and written proficiency in German and English What We Offer - Modern infrastructure: Well-positioned workplace with views of Lake of the Four Cantons, Pilatus, and Rigi - Personal development: Opportunities for training and professional growth - Social benefits: - Good social benefits (NBU, employer contribution to 60% pension) - Free parking and public transport: Free parking and access to electric charging stations, public transport contribution - Catering: Lunch voucher with 50% employer participation, free coffee, tea, water, and fruit - Daycare: Discount for our connected daycare facility - Discounts: Various discounts for recreational activities - Fitness: Access to fitness equipment Contact Cereneo – Centre for Neurology & Rehabilitation, Weggis (LU), Switzerland Start date: After agreement
